public_url.name: Fixed HTTPS address for this Nocturne
public_url.description: Use the certificate hostname and configured host port, not an IP address or /setup path. Do not casually change the hostname after registering passkeys.

certificate.name: Certificate filename
certificate.description: Filename in /ssl, for example fullchain.pem. Also specify the private key. Both empty creates only a temporary startup-test certificate.

private_key.name: Private key filename
private_key.description: Filename in /ssl, for example privkey.pem. Never paste key contents here. It must match the certificate.

gateway_auth.name: Extra username/password popup
gateway_auth.description: On: extra code from the HA status page, required for first owner setup. Off: go directly to Nocturne passkey login, only after completed owner setup with configured trusted certificates. Nocturne authentication stays enabled. Save and restart only this app.

network.8448/tcp: Nocturne HTTPS: host port must match the fixed HTTPS address. Router port forwarding is not needed.
